name: Electropellers
summary: Electropellers is a lighthearted errand for the eccentric gnome tinkerer Wizbang Cranktoggle in Auberdine. After losing his bag of prototype components in Darkshore's freshwater streams during a misadventure with an explosive duck decoy, Wizbang asks passing anglers to fish them back out.

sections.title: A Tipsy Invention
sections.body: Wizbang Cranktoggle, a gnome tinkerer stationed in the quiet night elf port of Auberdine, spent an evening wandering inland Darkshore searching for testing grounds. His latest passion project was a self-propelled, exploding duck decoy. Unfortunately, a bit too much drink led to an untimely blackout. Wizbang woke hours later back in town with singed hair and a completely empty pack, having accidentally dropped his precious bag of electropellers into one of the coastal rivers.

sections.title: Dredging the Waters
sections.body: Rather than brave the wilds himself to retrieve his scattered mechanical parts, Wizbang calls upon local fishermen to dredge the freshwater streams of Darkshore. Anglers casting lines across waterways like the Wildbend River and Cliffspring River frequently snag these buoyant, metallic gizmos alongside the local fish. Recovering the components allows the oblivious gnome to resume his dangerously erratic waterfowl experiments.

faq.q: Where do I find the electropellers?
faq.answer: They must be fished out of Darkshore's freshwater rivers and lakes, such as the Cliffspring River or the Wildbend River. They will not appear in the ocean waters along the coast.

Wizbang is an eccentric gnomish engineer residing in Auberdine. Known for bizarre and explosive inventions, he relies on adventurous travelers to gather lost components and oddities for his experiments.

faq.q: What was Wizbang trying to build?
faq.answer: He was working on a self-propelled, exploding duck decoy. His testing went awry after he indulged in a bit too much drink and accidentally detonated an early prototype, scorching his hair and losing his bag of parts in the water.

faq.q: Can electropellers be found in fish schools?
faq.answer: No, electropellers are hauled up from open freshwater casts. Casting your line directly into special schools, such as Lesser Oily Blackmouth nodes, will not yield the mechanical parts.
You must first complete Gaffer Jacks, an earlier fishing task Wizbang assigns to test your angling luck in the local waters.
No. They cannot be looted from enemies or found in ground containers; they must be retrieved from the rivers using a fishing pole.

angles.text: Wizbang's chaotic ambition to build exploding duck decoys is a familiar sight to any gnome, even if losing expensive parts in an elf-guarded river is slightly embarrassing.
Electropellers are curious examples of miniaturized gnomish propulsion, designed to drive mechanical decoys before violently combusting.
Local night elves look upon Wizbang's loud, smoky inventions and river-littering mishaps with quiet disapproval, preferring Darkshore's streams remain natural.
